title: Double Booked
description: The API deliberately allows a dispatcher to schedule the same driver for two overlapping shipments — real dispatch boards let mistakes happen. Prove the conflict-detection endpoint catches it anyway.
successCondition: Create two assignments for the same driverId (different shipments/vehicles) with overlapping scheduledStart/scheduledEnd windows. GET /api/fleet/conflicts then includes an entry with resourceType "driver", resourceId equal to that driver's id, and assignmentIds containing both assignment ids.
hints: PUT /api/fleet/assignments/:shipmentId does not reject overlapping schedules — that's intentional, see docs/api/fleet.md.
"Overlapping" means the two time windows intersect at all, not that they're identical.
